pick_rule: best 1-2 by (verdict rank, Holm p, net $) on the 51 in-sample days; both are only 'weak'

common.window_et: signal bar opens 09:45-15:00 (mod 585..900), >= 20 trades, footprint present, 12 prior bars contiguous
common.pool: UP push: bars i-3..i-1 all close>open AND high[i] > max(high[i-12..i-1]); DOWN mirror (close<open, new 12-bar low)
common.trade: fade (d = -push); entry = market at bar i+1 open + 18 ticks against; stop = 1 tick beyond bar i's extreme; target 2R from fill, needs 1 tick through; exits on closed 5m bars, stop first, stop fill 2 ticks worse (gap: open - 2 ticks); flat at the 15:55 bar close - 2 ticks; $1.90 rt per micro; one position at a time (busy rule)

X1.name: fade, thin top (exhaustion print)
X1.label: bar range >= 24 ticks; aggressive (ask for up push, bid for down) volume per tick in the 8 ticks nearest the extreme <= 0.33 x per tick in ticks 8..23 from the extreme (and the latter > 0)

X4.name: fade, thin top + delta exhaustion
X4.label: X1's THIN AND delta x push > 0 on each of bars i-3..i-1 AND delta[i] x push <= 0.33 x their mean

oos: python -X utf8 research/orderflow/v5/exhaustion/oos.py  (days in data/pc_days not listed above, >= 50,000 trades)
